category_edits.rationale: Scale each feed-forward residual update by 0.5 to reduce update magnitude while preserving the SASRec causal Transformer, attention branches, and all training settings. The generated predictor imports SASRec from train.py, so inference automatically uses the same scaled residual architecture with one checkpoint per category.

response.change_summary: Apply fixed 0.5 scaling to every feed-forward residual branch for all four category models; the predictor shares the updated architecture through its existing import.
